beats.headline: Larracos
beats.text: They come down into Larracos at the start of a sixty-hour ceasefire. Nine armies ring the drowned city like slices of a pie, the city's own NPCs defend it as the tenth team, and whoever takes the castle at the bottom of the well wins. Carl and Donut are warlords of one of the nine, the Princess Posse. Carl carries a secret from Christmas morning. The Residual's coffee held an illegal implant, a Containment Interface, that can trip the failsafe and turn the sun nova. Donut becomes a Deathbed Hellcat, a long-range sniper who comes with a ghillie suit. Elle is a Hailstorm Queen. Mordecai is a human Canadian in a raccoon hat with his best alchemy table yet. Carl drinks a Hell-Kissed potion that lets him turn briefly incorporeal and pass through things. He adopts Tserendolgor's baby tummy acher and names it Sir Rendlegore, which Donut takes as a betrayal. Katia's hair tonic gives him hair to his waist. Louis's celestial box brings him a war airship called the Party Planner. Juice Box has woken Larracos's NPCs to what they are, calls herself Warlord, and wants to seal the alliance by marrying Louis. Ferdinand, mayor of the shantytown outside the walls, holds her team's warlord interface, and Carl trades him back his hat and his rhinoceros for the mayoralty. The Desperado Club reopens under new management: Hamed, the Night Wyrm. The Dream has bought Signet's old show, Vengeance of the Daughter, and wants its third season.

beats.headline: Fifty thousand
beats.text: At the Posse's headquarters Carl finds Rosetta, a former crawler called Tipid, a skyfowl called Justice Light, and fifty thousand former crawlers who came down in the garbage freighter to fight for him. Tipid explains that Doctor Hu, who wrote the Cookbook's second edition, gathered them. Carl cries. The castle is called the Fortress of Unyielding Power and Authority, and Donut forbids anyone to read out the initials. An elite sent by the company behind Signet's old show walks in wearing satchel charges, and Baroness Victory, their adjutant, cuts him down. Carl's spam folder shows Shi Maria trying to cast through him, blocked by a toe ring he has barely noticed. Mordecai brews Glory Bound. For Katia, a trip into her worst memory to cure the drugs. For Carl, a trip into the spider's worst memory, to lock her inside it. They hold hands going under, and their dreams bleed together: a children's hospital in Iceland, and Annie. Inside the dream Shi Maria's husband Hapanzi seals her in Carl like an egg only Carl can break. Meanwhile the Lemig Sortion and the Madness cheat. They time a Summon Ally spell with outside knowledge to pull Carl's sleeping body into their base and let the spider loose on the Posse. Carl wakes in the Lemig headquarters, standing in a circle of fifty dead goblins. At the hearing, the adjutants replay Katia's dream for everyone. The Lemig commander looks into the eye on Carl's chest, goes mad and kills himself. The ceasefire ends early, and the Madness's Architect Houston shoots Carl through the shoulder as he teleports home.

beats.headline: Over the top
beats.text: In flashback: on Christmas morning, beside a sleeping memory dog, Carl opened the containment interface, found the button that would destroy everything, and pressed the one beside it instead. Disconnect Containment. The failsafe is dead, and the AI's sphere begins to grow. Now the war starts. On the southern front the Posse holds against the Dream, the Prism Kingdom and the nagas, then against a swarm of the Reavers' plague-carrying pets. Carl orders enemies taken alive where possible. Then they go on the attack. Louis's bombs make craters in no man's land, fifty trap speakers blast Killing in the Name, and two thousand invisible soldiers go over the top. In the craters they read Build Trench scrolls to dig straight into the enemy lines, a craft-magic exploit nobody ever fixed. Carl lands on a Saccathian soldier with the Daughter's Kiss, blows their trench apart and knocks himself out for twenty-five seconds. They take the Prism castle. Carl puts the Ring of Divine Suffering's mark on Empress D'nadia and finds himself standing on an edge, wanting to kill her with his own hands more than he has wanted anything. He steps back. Donut tells the Empress that Mongo would like to express his disappointment at how she judged the pet show, and Mongo kills her. Carl's stats now make him party leader of the Royal Court. Donut begs him to throw the ring away because it is changing him. Not yet, he says.

beats.headline: The king's daughter
beats.text: Agatha turns up in the shantytown asking for Carl by name, and the Syndicate's prime minister sends word to stay away from her. The Reavers come through the Posse's own saferoom door, and Valtay worms have taken over the Posse's mages, so the fortress fills with enemies from inside. Carl punches one worm out of a dead man's face, and Donut stands on the roof shouting Comrades and sets Big Tina loose. Then the Skull Empire's army arrives under King Rust, the Maestro's father, and asks to parley. The king is crying. His daughter, Princess Formidable, has taken one of his warships and told the Syndicate she will trip the failsafe herself to keep the rogue AI away from the centre of the galaxy. He wants Carl to beg her to stop for the sake of Earth's people. Carl laughs, trades a truce for a withdrawal, and privately tells Donut not to worry, because it won't work. He knows the failsafe is dead because he killed it. On the walk back Rosetta kills the king, uses his ring and his eye on a data pad, and empties his accounts. His army attacks. At the same moment a former crawler called Volteeg, commanding a Weeper for the Operatic Collective, detonates it, killing ten thousand soldiers and his own warlord. The Operatic Collective is out of the war. Carl, Donut and Rosetta fall into a tunnel the Semeru dwarves dug under the field.

beats.headline: A drink with the AI
beats.text: Orren pulls Carl into his office. His people know about Paulie and the implant, and they cannot work out how it functions. Then Growler Gary walks in, except it is the AI wearing him, drinking vodka and unhappy with Orren for trying to have Carl killed. It teleports Princess Formidable into the room to show everyone that the button she pressed did nothing, then drops her on Earth. It asks their advice, in a long metaphor about a boyfriend in prison, on whether to side with Agatha's Residuals or the Apothecary. Donut tells it to stay out of it until it knows whether the boyfriend is good or bad. The Bloc of enemy teams starts to break up. Katia tattoos Carl with one of Li Na's spells in ink made from the pacifist network's root vegetable. Zev reports that when Formidable's crew hit the button, a whole other star system went dark. At the warlord council Stalwart punches the commentator, a system message announces that Scolopendra stirs, and Juice Box turns into something she calls one of the Unwashed and tells the galaxy it is coming for them all. Then Odette mentions that the Blood Sultanate owns the company that made Blood Hunter, the show that killed Miriam Dom. Carl starts laughing and cannot stop. The nagas have so few troops because most of their army is already dead.

beats.headline: Operation Snake Pit
beats.text: Donut cannot leave this floor until every royal of the Blood Sultanate is dead, and Katia, crowned by Eva, is bound the same way. Operation Snake Pit was supposed to take care of it. Prepotente, level 99, got there first: most of the naga army is already dead at his hooves, revenge for Miriam. He lands, says recruit me, and sobs that Carl is his best friend. Carl makes him a colonel. Elle and Imani kill a royal inside the naga castle. Their sultana, Vinata, has been escaping death every season by slipping into Club Vanquisher and a god's temple. So Carl, Katia, Prepotente and Samantha break into the club, with a wire carrying Li Na's dread auras ahead of them that turns the guards against themselves in horrible ways. Samantha opens the door to the temple of Khepri, and it is a trap with a god inside. The Scavenger's Daughter gives Carl ninety seconds of immortality in a god's presence. He summons a fat one-hit creature called Günter and sets off a bomb at his own feet in a narrow room, and survives being turned inside out. Everything else dies except the god and Vinata. Gods spill out into the club. Hellik steps out to banish Khepri and gives Carl a message for Emberus: Hellik did not kill his son, Apito has been corrupted, and Nekhebit is behind it. Carl's disease ring overloads, the slugpox comes back, and a sluggalette called Bigs kills Vinata the second her immortality runs out. In a hidden guild Carl finds Milk, who wrote in the Cookbook, and holds her while he cries.

beats.headline: Operation Ruin
beats.text: The Posse builds the Nest, a granite tower that Donut wants painted purple, designed to draw every long-range spell on the battlefield while she snipes from the top. Their captive naga, Rishi, tells Carl a Syndicate court has named him the de facto leader of Earth, and offers Earth's natives citizenship if the nagas can settle the rest of the solar system. Carl marks him and kills him. Then Operation Ruin: four offensives at once. Florin takes the orcs, Boomer the Reavers, Donut the Dream from the Nest, and Carl the Madness. Louis flies bombing runs with Carl aboard to make the bombs bigger. Elle opens the Gate of the Feral Gods, and out come Meatus, a gremlin wearing a god's stolen penis, and Harpocrates, the god of silence, who wants it back. The Semeru set off a volcano in Reaver territory. Someone summons Eris, goddess of chaos, and a demon eviction begins. Then Prince Stalwart teleports in with Akuma, leader of a war mage rebellion, and explodes. Akuma takes the Gate and vanishes. Carl realises everyone keeps making plans around him without telling him. A dragon appears over the Reaver castle, Yarilo comes out of the Gate chasing Samantha, and in the Madness territory Osvaldo, who belongs to no army, holds up Apito's memorial crystal, which blazes into a rainbow the size of a hill and brings the whole Madness down on Carl's group.

beats.headline: The ball of everyone
beats.text: The Viceroys of the Madness pour psionics into Carl. A friendly voice tells him to look at his feet. They are buried in the root of an All Tree, and his Mind Balance jumps to sixteen as the tree dies behind him. Then Eris casts the Ceremony of Chaos. Everyone but Carl, the sluggalos and the strippers freezes, and she piles them all, friends and enemies, into a heap beside the Dream castle, conscious and invulnerable. The Party Planner is torn open and Louis falls into the Reaver castle. Donut commits an atrocity. With a stolen spell from a skunk's hat and her tower behind it, she rolls the pile into one enormous ball and drives it like a remote-control car. Meatus pulls Eris into it with him. When Harpocrates chases it, she plays Lollipop at him over the PA. Carl and a stripper named Dong break into the Madness castle, with Dong's sapient sock-flail advising them. They find Architect Houston grafting himself onto a changeling on his own surgical table, with a captive crawler, Burcu, tongueless and chained beside him. Carl phases through Houston and kills him. Burcu dies in the traps. Across the field Harpocrates marks Donut for death, and Li Jun throws himself in the way, and it costs him his life. The Madness is defeated, the Peeling phase opens Larracos to attack, and the war mages, recognised as a team at last under a warlord named Agatha, occupy the castle. Donut drives the ball onto a field of corpses and raises every skin in it to attack the enemies trapped inside. The system calls it her second atrocity.

beats.headline: War Crime
beats.text: If the war mages hold the castle for six hours, they win. Carl finds their generator and drops an entire inventory folder of explosives on it, labelled Shit Just Hit. The generator goes, and so does every window in the area. Lucia Mar comes up the Nest's stairs after Donut and Mongo, killing Bomo and Toyotomi on the way, and nets Donut in the tower. Donut rolls barrels down at her like Donkey Kong. Raul fights her, Rend saves Mongo by killing Lucia's dog Gustavo, and Carl pours a conscription potion Li Na stole into her. Carl puts on his ring to finish her, and a different voice answers, a child's, who says her name is Diah. There are a hundred and twenty thousand children inside Lucia, and killing her kills the children on Earth's surface. The admins pull her out. Agatha walks off her post. Rosetta, Milk and the tortoise Edgar give Donut a tattoo of a dog on her flank, and it carries a spell from a god in Nekhebit's court. Carl reads the long description of her War Crime spell: two hundred mercenaries paralysed and burning for two weeks. He agrees anyway. From the top of the collapsing Nest, trapped by Lucia's second net, Donut casts it. A spectral paw the size of a district hangs over the ball of enemies, and she swipes down. Three baps, then again, until the screaming stops. The third atrocity makes her the Oak Fell and Champion of Nekhebit. At level one hundred and thirty-five she is the most powerful crawler in the history of the game. Li Na, who marked everyone in the ball, maxes out every stat she has.

beats.headline: The long way round
beats.text: Akuma takes the war mages off the floor, and with them whatever they came for, something called the Scavenger's Daughter. On his way out he warns everyone that Agatha is an enemy to them all. The rescue team gets Louis out of the Reaver castle: Juice Box possesses him and teleports him out, leaving a pile of bombs, and the castle goes up with the dragon and the Reaver warlord hidden inside it. The Reavers were rebuilding Louis from the inside, and Epitome Tagg of the Dream is now his heart. The prime minister tries to have Carl ejected, and the AI stops him and threatens his children. Kiwi gives birth to Mongo's twins. Then Samantha admits she was involved in Geyrun's death, and Emberus comes for her, promising to burn the floor in sixty-six minutes either way. Everything happens at once. Katia eats the orchid. Mordecai and Edgar cut Louis open, pull Tagg's machinery out and give him naiad organs from Samantha's golem, and with Tagg dead the Dream is finished. Carl holds the Ring of Divine Suffering up to Donut, and she swallows it. The Sledge casts Zerzura, and all of Larracos, NPCs and all, goes to the twelfth floor, while the surviving former crawlers are put out of the dungeon. The Princess Posse wins Faction Wars. Donut's Laundry Day tears Huanxin Jinx out of Eileithyia, and a plain bolt tipped with Mordecai's mother's ashes kills her. Katia chooses to be made pregnant, which sends her to the surface, where there are children alone who need her. Juice Box goes into the Nothing to be reborn as a weapon. Justice Light springs his trap and breaks it open. Scolopendra wakes. And on the way down, Quasar mentions that Donut's new lawyer is Carl's wife.
